review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions in SpectralOverlapPaths.lean (spectralPathDensity, spectralGroupPath, spectralGroupDiagonal). cavityCanonicalCoordinate is a project-specific primitive. It integrates the density from 0 to the clamp of t onto [0,1]. It uses Mathlib's Set.projIcc, intervalIntegral and the subtype Icc (-1) 1, and it does not re-implement any Mathlib concept. cavityCanonicalLabel is only the same function bundled into a subtype. spectralGroupPath is a related project definition, but it integrates up to p s without clamping, so it is a different function, and the file links the two with the lemma cavityCanonicalCoordinate_at_path. I found no competing duplicate of a Mathlib concept. I did not look for duplicates of these definitions elsewhere in the project, since the rubric is about Mathlib.
